name: EPIC 248423072
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.3 solar radii and 0.80 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,934 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.80 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,866 K at its surface.
